name: Mocro Maffia
description: Best friends Romano, Potlood and De Paus rise in the rank of the criminal world. Before they know it, they run Amsterdam's entire coke market. Because of jealousy, their relation becomes complicated and ends up hostile.

videos.title: Nasrdin
videos.overview: Nasrdin Dchar talks about the dark side of his character Pencil in 'Mocro Maffia', season 2 and the curse of winning a Golden Calf.

videos.title: Bilal
videos.overview: Bilal Wahib talks about what it feels like to be a star and the gruesome ending of his character Mo The Show in 'Mocro Maffia', season 1. Does Mo go into the underworld?

videos.title: Mandela
videos.overview: Mandela Wee Wee reveals what role in 'Mocro Maffia' he actually auditioned for. He also talks about Romano's escape from prison and his complicated relationship with Celine in the series.

videos.title: Walid
videos.overview: Walid talks about the similarities and the differences between him and his character Adil. The second season of 'Mocro Maffia' will be extra exciting for Adil, as his family gets involved.

videos.title: Charlie Chan
videos.overview: Charlie Chan Dagelet talks about the development of her character from gangster girl to power woman in 'Mocro Maffia', season 2. She also talks about the dirty messages she receives from men on her social media.

videos.title: Oussama
videos.overview: Up-and-coming talent Oussama Ahammoud looks back on his audition for 'Mocro Maffia' and the dramatic twists and turns surrounding his character Mouse. Mouse going to get revenge?

videos.title: Oorlogsverklaring
videos.overview: Romano, Pencil and the Pope dominate Amsterdam's busy cocaine trade. When Pope betrays Romano and Pencil a vengeful war is set off between them. Away from the street, a seasoned journalist and his naive apprentice sense a headline story in the making.

videos.title: Prijs
videos.overview: As the gangs continue to move product across the city, pressure is mounting from both police and rivals. Journalist Rein de Waard comes to terms with a lifechanging decision, while Matthijs lays the groundwork for his risky investigation.

videos.title: Jaloezie
videos.overview: Romano seeks legal council to secure his personal future, and that of his empire. The Pope feels the pressure and Is ready to retaliate, while Matthijs sets out to prove himself to Rein with a headline story.

videos.title: Vijanden
videos.overview: Matthijs lands his front page story, as Rein's personal life takes a dramatic turn. While Romano is sentenced, both sides are prepared to increase the stakes, in order to rule the Amsterdam trade.

videos.title: Wapenstilstand
videos.overview: Adil demands a fifty-hour ceasefire from The Pope, who nonetheless takes his violent impulses elsewhere. Mouse's family attempt to coax him from a life of crime, while Romano in jail encounters old foes.

videos.title: Afscheid
videos.overview: A fresh wave of violence engulfs both street and prison. Mo The Show is dragged from Rein's investigation and back into the game.

videos.title: Ontvoering
videos.overview: The Pope's ruthless actions push several characters to the edge of their sanity. Meanwhile, Adil attempts to deal with the cash flow of the inherited empire and Rein struggles to cope with his loss.

videos.title: Oog Om Oog
videos.overview: An unexpected turn betrayal endangers the lives of both Rein and Mo, while Mouse and Adil plot to take action before more suffer at the hands of The Pope. In prison, Romano's circumstances change radically.

videos.title: Paraat
videos.overview: In hiding, Mouse tries to forget the death of his brother Elias. Rein has a hunch where to find Romano, but Mo the Show tries to talk him out of the search.

videos.title: xPurmerend19
videos.overview: Armed with a trunk full of weapons, Mouse and Silent open the hunt for Taliban together with new recruits Hook and Dominoes. When boredom strikes, they decide to rip up a bellhouse. This turns out to be a storage place of a group from the Bijlmer. Mo the Show is put under pressure by Matthijs.

videos.title: Welke Kk Zwemles
videos.overview: Romano and Pencil escaped from the country. Taxi surprises Pope and Tatta with a risky gift in the port of Rotterdam.

videos.title: Calabria Dinnemok
videos.overview: Mo is doing business on his own with Sandro, an Italian criminal who goes into hiding in Amsterdam. Pencil and Eiffel are on the road together to do a job for Ian.

videos.title: Ewa Maghrebi
videos.overview: Mouse and Domino's get a bad message about their friend Hook. Pope goes to Antwerp for an appointment with the Colombian Tia Alvarez.

videos.title: Jagen
videos.overview: Adils gets cornered when he hears that Mouse's father is talking to the police. Mo the Show gets promoted. Taliban are finally allowed to hunt for Pope.

videos.title: Komt goed
videos.overview: Pencil returns to Amsterdam, but stumbles upon a dissatisfied Smooth and unreachable Adil.

videos.title: Niet Mijn Winkel, Vriend
videos.overview: The search for Romano continues. In the meantime, De Paus is busy getting a large shipment of coke out of the harbor. Tatta is put in charge and runs the operation from a holiday park. Adil is sitting with his lawyer Edith Roodschild at his first session and is slightly tense. Taxi's choices from the past continue to haunt him, while the field of work expands to the Bijlmer. Justice decides to launch the counterattack.

videos.title: Wollah Meh Ik Heb Iets Gezegd!
Die Abramovich Money Is Gek, Hè?
videos.overview: Tonnano gives orders to find Komtgoed. Samira is haunted both indoors and out by the aftermath of Mo the Show's shooting. Tatta and Paus pull out all the stops to find the Mexicans who were behind the torture container.

videos.title: Bloed Pissen
videos.overview: The hunt for Komtgoed is intensified by Tonnano and Cinqo. This is getting out of hand for him and his friends. Samira feels Detective El Moussaoui gasping in her neck as he investigates Mo de Show's death. As a result, the distance between her and Taxi increases and Samira radicalises further and further.

videos.title: Was Je Op Kk Excursie, Of Zo?
videos.overview: Potlood and Tatta are waiting in Düsseldorf with the Colombians of Tia Alvarez for a moment to catch the Mexicans, but this is more difficult than expected. Tonnano tries to fix the loose ends of the failed liquidation attempt on El Moussaoui for Paus. Romano outlines his future plans for Adil, but whether Adil feels like it is questionable.

videos.title: Ich spreche Met Haar, A. Hitler
videos.overview: Taxi has a long way to go to arrange his affairs for Tonnano and Tonnano notices this more and more. Taxi tries to score points with Tonnano by investigating who could be behind the hit on the Zaalvoetbal. Komtgoed and his friends get restless from being in hiding and go out. But this puts them at greater risk of being caught.

videos.title: Wie Is Zijn Neef?
videos.overview: The discovery of Taxi about Zafer and the Turks gives Paus a new position in the conflict with the Mexicans and Turks from Germany. But when Tatta returns from his failed revenge expedition, it poses a whole new problem. Al Moussaoui, in turn, is doing everything he can to close the net around Samira. Romano forces Potlood to give up Paus's location.

videos.title: Hoe Dom Zijn Jullie Eigenlijk?
videos.overview: Escaped from the clutches of the law, Taxi tries a new plan, but soon finds an obstacle in his way. Komtgoed looks for relaxation during a new date with Youssra, but the question is whether he knows what to expect. Paus receives help from an unexpected source and makes a discovery that will benefit him greatly.

videos.title: We Zijn Geen Snitches
videos.overview: Romano can no longer go anywhere in Germany. Adil and Meltem have fled and Ömer has had it with him and seeks a deal with Pope. Hassan, Ibo's father, takes Komtgoed to a re-education camp, where he is reunited with Havik, Scennoe and Stuiver. But there, Komtgoed finds no peace when he encounters an old acquaintance.

videos.title: You Are Never Safe
videos.overview: Taxi has to run for his life as Dominique takes her revenge on Zafer and Paus doesn't trust Al Moussaoui's PGPs. The pressure on Tonnano to silence Al Moussaoui comes to a head. Adil's wild run only causes trouble. And Romano is determined to settle the feud with Paus once and for all.

videos.title: Staatsvijand Yek?!
videos.overview: While Tonnano and Samira hunt Tatta, Paus confers with Tia. Meanwhile, the tension between Taxi and Van Jaren rises and Adil and Meltem look for a way forward.

videos.title: De Koning Is Dood, Leve De Koning
videos.overview: Celine is cornered by Romano's cousin Borsu. Komgoed and Hawk argue with each other. Tatta and Otto take steps to cut off the group of Paus.

videos.title: Just Thieves And Assassini
videos.overview: Van Jaren competes with both Taxi and Samira. Adil has nowhere to go and goes looking for Meltem. Paus makes new enemies and makes an irreversible decision.

videos.title: De Nood Die De Wet Breekt
videos.overview: The actions of Paus create opportunities for Tatta, but his brother Otto also wants a piece of the pie. Celine is further pressured by Borsu and must delve into her past. Potlood feels its time has come.

videos.title: Sing Like Pavarotti
videos.overview: Now that the goal of Potlood has been achieved, a new battle erupts. The whole world is turned upside down and the relationships are sharper than ever. Who will pull the longest straw?

videos.title: Schoenen Uit!
videos.overview: Ashraf returns with the cargo from Italy, but Samira's problems with Taxi are not solved yet. Otto wants to prove his worth and takes an unexpected step. Adil and Meltem are further cornered.

videos.title: Je Praat Teveel
videos.overview: Samira, Tonnano and Ashraf must decide what to do with the corpse, while Potlood pushes ahead with his short but brutal war. Adil gets an opportunity from an unexpected source. And on the hunt to collect his last kilos, Tatta must pull out all the stops.

videos.title: Ik Ben Hier Alleen He!
videos.overview: Samira and Ashraf are seeking revenge for the murder of Paus, but Tia Alvarez seems untraceable. Tatta is trying to keep his head above water and makes a new attempt to make peace with Tonnano. Adil is fighting for his life but is tormented by memories of his deceased family members.

videos.title: Je Wou Pap, Toch?
videos.overview: Samira and Ashraf are visiting a funeral in Antwerp and ramping up their pursuit of Tia. While Tonnano arranges new weapons and soldiers, he receives news that will change his life forever. As Celine finds herself cornered, Tatta forms an alliance with Borsu to establish a new cocaine route in Suriname.

videos.title: Graaf Door
videos.overview: Adil is doing everything he can to avoid a life sentence and to seek justice for Muis's death. Samira and Ashraf gain more power in Antwerp and focus on Tia's customs officers. Tonnano gets on the trail of Tatta's family but increasingly struggles with his own conscience.

videos.title: Paus Had Een Naam
videos.overview: When Tatta discovers why Otto is in a wheelchair, it seems there is no possibility of reconciliation. Tonnano and Samira come into direct conflict when Samira finds out that Tonnano is withholding money. Celine fears being unmasked as Romano's murderer and wants to flee with her daughter.

videos.title: Mensen Waar Je Niks Mee Te Maken Wil Hebben
videos.overview: Adil takes Komtgoed under his wing, and they make a list of their targets. Due to the problems with the new Surinamese cocaine pipeline, the collaboration between Tatta and Borsu is on the verge of breaking down. Samira becomes more ruthless in her fight against Tia, resulting in innocent victims. Ashraf doubts Samira's leadership and contemplates his future.

videos.title: Kleine Jonguun
videos.overview: Taxi returns and tries to convince Samira to leave the business. Borsu feels betrayed by Tatta and brings in Adil to get his revenge. Ashraf goes on a search for the person who drove his younger brother to death and makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Hele Straat Weg
videos.overview: Tatta and Tonnano are expecting a new shipment of coke, but Adil and Komtgoed are hot on their heels and it's threatening to erupt into an explosive confrontation. Ashraf forces Samira and Taxi to hand over Pope's inheritance to him, but Samira isn't giving in so easily.

videos.title: Elke Week Een Begrafenis
videos.overview: While Samira does her best to shake off the police, Taxi desperately tries to make a deal to save his family. Tonnano wants to leave the cocaine business behind but still has some dangerous matters to settle before he can start a new life.
